zh: 服务器昨晚宕机了。
en: The server {went down|crashed|fell over} last night.
note: Go down means a system stops working. Down is bad and up is good when we talk about servers.

zh: 好消息，网站恢复正常了。
en: Good news, the site's {back up|back online|up again|working again}.
note: Back up means working again after it was down. Here it is not about making a backup.

zh: VPN恢复连接了吗？
en: Is the VPN {back online|back up|working again} yet?
note: Back online means connected and working again. Back shows it returned to its normal state.

zh: 刚才停电了，不过现在来电了。
en: The power went out, but it's {back on} now.
note: Back on means working again after being off. We also say the power went out or went off.

zh: 等来电了以后，重启一下路由器。
en: Once the power comes {back on|on}, restart the router.
note: Come back on means start working again by itself, for example when the power returns.

zh: 检查一下停电后所有服务器有没有重新启动起来。
en: Check that all the servers {came back up|came back on|came back online|powered back on} after the power cut.
note: Come back up means start running again after going down. People say power cut in New Zealand and Britain.

zh: 更新之后你得重新登录。
en: You'll need to {log back in|sign back in|log in again|sign in again} after the update.
note: Log back in means log in again. Back goes between the verb and in.

zh: 走之前别忘了退出登录。
en: Don't forget to {log out|sign out|log off} before you leave.
note: Log out means leave your account so nobody else can use it. Out is the opposite of in.

zh: 你能用你的工作账号登录吗？
en: Can you {sign in|log in} with your work account?
note: Sign in and log in mean the same thing. In shows you go into the system.

zh: 我的账号被锁了，进不去，你能帮我重置吗？
en: I've been {locked out} of my account. Can you reset it?
note: Locked out means you cannot get in because the system has blocked you, like a locked door.

zh: 我填表的时候会话超时了。
en: My session {timed out|expired} while I was filling in the form.
note: Time out means stop because you waited too long. Out shows the time has run out.

zh: 如果出了问题，我们可以回滚到上一个版本。
en: If anything goes wrong, we can {roll back|revert|go back} to the previous version.
note: Roll back means return to an earlier version. Back shows you go back to how it was.

zh: 我们下周开始给销售团队陆续配发新电脑。
en: We're {rolling out} the new laptops to the sales team next week.
note: Roll out means start giving something new to many people, often step by step.

zh: 我先快速建一台测试服务器给你试试。
en: I'll {spin up|set up|fire up} a test server so you can try it.
note: Spin up means quickly create and start a server or environment, usually in the cloud.

zh: 我们周五要把旧的文件服务器彻底关停。
en: We're {shutting down|switching off|turning off|decommissioning|retiring} the old file server on Friday.
note: Shut down can mean close something for good, not only turn it off for the night.

zh: 我的电脑早上开机要花很长时间。
en: My laptop takes ages to {boot up|start up|boot|start} in the morning.
note: Boot up means start a computer. Up often shows something becomes ready.

zh: 显示器插上电了吗？
en: Is the monitor {plugged in|connected}?
note: Plugged in means connected to the power or a port. In shows it goes into the socket.

zh: 把它拔掉，等十秒，再重新插上。
en: {Unplug|Disconnect} it, wait ten seconds, then plug it {back in}.
note: Unplug means take the plug out. Plug it back in means put it in again.

zh: 系统每天凌晨两点自动备份数据库。
en: The system {backs up} the database every night at two.
note: Back up is the verb, written as two words. Backup as one word is the noun, as in a backup.

zh: 你拿到电脑以后备份过吗？
en: Have you {backed up} your laptop since you got it?
note: The verb is back up, so the past form is backed up. A backup is the copy you make.

zh: 我正在备份整个硬盘，别关机。
en: I'm {backing up|copying} the whole drive, so don't turn it off.
note: Backing up is the verb form. You are backing up, and when you finish you have a backup.

zh: 你能把旧文件清理掉吗？硬盘快满了。
en: Can you {clear out|clean out|delete|get rid of} your old files? The drive's nearly full.
note: Clear out means remove things you don't need to make space. Out shows they go away.

zh: 我们把代码仓库里的旧分支清理一下吧。
en: Let's {clean up|tidy up|clear out|delete|remove|get rid of} the old branches in the repo.
note: Clean up means make something tidy by removing what is old or not needed. Up means completely.

zh: 会议室的无线网是谁装的？
en: Who {set up|installed|configured} the Wi-Fi in the meeting room?
note: Set up means install something and make it ready to use. The noun is a setup.

zh: 滚动到页面最下面，然后点保存。
en: Scroll {down} to the bottom and click Save.
note: Scroll down means move lower on the page. Scroll up means move back towards the top.

zh: 你能放大一下吗？字太小了。
en: Can you {zoom in}? The text is too small.
note: Zoom in means make things on the screen look bigger. In shows you move closer.

zh: 你能缩小一点吗？这样我们能看到整张图。
en: Can you zoom {out} a bit so we can see the whole diagram?
note: Zoom out means make things look smaller so you see more. Out shows you move further away.

zh: 开始之前，先把最新的代码改动拉下来。
en: Make sure you {pull down|pull|fetch} the latest changes before you start.
note: Pull down means copy the latest changes from the server to your computer. Down shows it comes to you.

zh: 我已经把修复推上去了，你能审一下吗？
en: I've {pushed up|pushed} a fix. Can you review it?
note: Push up means send your changes from your computer to the server. Up is the opposite of pull down.

zh: 你应该开启双重身份验证。
en: You should {turn on|switch on|set up|enable} two-factor authentication.
note: Turn on a setting means start using it. Turn off means stop using it.

zh: 你随时可以退出测试版。
en: You can opt {out} of the beta at any time.
note: Opt out means choose not to take part any more. Opt in means choose to join.

zh: 演示的时候应用程序又崩了。
en: The app {fell over|crashed|died|went down} again during the demo.
note: In New Zealand and Britain, fall over is a casual way to say a system crashed.

zh: 我的电脑又出毛病了，老是自己重启。
en: My laptop's {playing up|acting up} again. It keeps restarting.
note: Play up is New Zealand and British English for not working properly. Americans say act up.

zh: 构建服务器现在正常运行了吗？
en: Is the build server {up and running|up|running|back up} now?
note: Up and running means started and working properly. Up alone also means working.

zh: 无线网老是断。
en: The Wi-Fi keeps {dropping out|cutting out|dropping}.
note: Drop out means the connection stops for a short time. Out shows it disappears for a moment.

zh: 你试过关机再重新开机吗？
en: Have you tried turning it {off} and {on} again?
note: Turn it off and on again is the classic first step in IT support. Off comes first, then on.

zh: 我的屏幕老是自己黑掉。
en: My screen keeps {going off|turning off|switching off|going black} by itself.
note: Go off means stop working or switch off by itself. Turn off usually means a person does it.

zh: 你今晚能把电脑正常关机吗？我们要装更新。
en: Can you {shut down|turn off|switch off|power off} your computer properly tonight? We're installing updates.
note: Shut down a computer means close everything and turn it off properly.

zh: 补丁今晚会发布出去。
en: The patch will {go out|roll out|be released|be deployed} tonight.
note: Go out means be sent or released to people. Out shows it leaves the team and reaches users.

zh: 我们今晚要把数据库停掉做维护。
en: We're taking the database {down|offline} for maintenance tonight.
note: Take something down means stop it on purpose. It is down until you bring it back up.

zh: 是我的问题，还是Outlook挂了？
en: Is it just me, or is Outlook {down|offline}?
note: Down means not working for anyone. People say this when email or a website stops working.

zh: 你能在共享盘上腾出点空间吗？
en: Can you {free up|clear|make} some space on the shared drive?
note: Free up means make something available by removing what uses it. Up means completely.

zh: 我查一下这个错误代码。
en: Let me {look up|search for|google|check} the error code.
note: Look up means find information about something, for example online or in a list.

zh: 这个任务跑到一半报错中断了。
en: The job {errored out|failed|crashed|fell over|died} halfway through.
note: Error out means stop because of an error. Out shows the process ended early.

zh: 你能把管理员账号的权限收紧吗？
en: Can you {lock down|secure|restrict} the admin accounts?
note: Lock down means make something very secure and limit who can use it. Down means firmly.

zh: 我们周六切换到新系统。
en: We're {cutting over|switching over|moving over|migrating|switching} to the new system on Saturday.
note: Cut over means switch from the old system to the new one at a set time.

zh: 我把通知关了，这样能专心工作。
en: I {turned off|switched off|muted|disabled} notifications so I can focus.
note: Turn off notifications means stop them appearing. Off is the opposite of on.

zh: 几分钟后无线网自己恢复了。
en: The Wi-Fi {came back on|came back|came back up} by itself after a few minutes.
note: Came back on means started working again without anyone fixing it.

zh: 我的手机打电话打到一半没电了。
en: My battery {ran out|died|went flat} halfway through the call.
note: Run out means there is none left. A battery that has run out is flat.

zh: 每次我打开Teams，风扇就开始转。
en: The fan {kicks in|comes on|starts up} whenever I open Teams.
note: Kick in means start working automatically when needed. In shows it joins the action.
